_spec.purpose: 多益 Part 4 簡短獨白題庫；一組＝一段獨白＋3題四選一

easy.guide: 單一主題、6–8 句、答案幾乎照字面出現、無圖表

medium.guide: 8–10 句、同義換句、有 but／however 轉折、至少 1 題推論或意圖

hard.guide: 10–14 句、先說 A 再更正為 B、含圖表題或意圖題、資訊密集

qtypes.main: 主旨／目的／問題／職業／地點
qtypes.intent: 意圖（題目引用對話中一句話）
qtypes.graphic: 圖表題，題目以 Look at the graphic 開頭，須有 graphic
qtypes.who: 身份（說話者或聽眾是誰）

_spec.entry_schema: {id:d{1-7}-{3位數}-{e|m|h}, domain, scene, mtype(須在 mtypes 內), tag(中文,不重複), form:'talk', level:{score,cefr,tier,why}, speakers:[單一{id:'S',gender:'F'|'M',role}], script:[{t,zh}], graphic:null|{title,columns:[],rows:[[]]}, questions:[{id:'q1',qtype,q:{t,zh},choices:剛好4個{t,zh,ok,trap(錯誤句,取自traps)|pattern(正解:direct|paraphrase|summary),why}, evidence:[script句索引從0起,遞增]}] 共3題, vocab:[2–4個{word,ipa,pos,col,zh}]}

rules.choices: 每題 4 選項、剛好 1 正解；正解盡量用同義替換，不照抄對話原字；錯誤選項需有明確對話依據可排除。
rules.order: 3 題的 evidence 依題號遞增。
rules.output: 輸出單一合法 JSON 陣列（UTF-8、不加程式碼區塊標記）。
rules.script: 單一說話者獨白（沒有對話）；每句 5–25 字，口語自然、符合 mtype 的開場與結尾慣例；初級 6–8 句、中級 8–10 句、高級 10–14 句。
rules.graphic: 圖表題以 Look at the graphic 開頭，答案須結合圖表與獨白（獨白更正圖表上的資訊，或需用兩個條件對照）。
rules.intent: 意圖題的引號句必須逐字出現在 script 中。

level.why: 單一主題的公司公告，答案幾乎照字面出現。

script.t: Good morning, everyone. This is an announcement from the Human Resources department.
script.zh: 大家早安。這是人資部門的公告。

script.t: Starting next Monday, all employees will need a new photo badge to enter the building.
script.zh: 從下週一起，所有員工都需要新的照片識別證才能進入大樓。

script.t: The old cards will stop working at nine a.m. that day.
script.zh: 舊卡片當天上午九點就會失效。

script.t: To get your new badge, please visit the security desk in the main lobby.
script.zh: 要領取新識別證，請到大廳的警衛櫃檯。

script.t: The desk is open from eight to five, Monday through Friday.
script.zh: 櫃檯週一到週五的八點到五點開放。

script.t: Please bring your old card and a photo ID with you.
script.zh: 請帶著舊卡片和一張附照片的身分證件。

script.t: If you have any questions, contact Ms. Lopez at extension 204. Thank you.
script.zh: 如有任何問題，請撥分機 204 聯絡 Lopez 女士。謝謝。

q.t: Who is the announcement intended for?
q.zh: 這則公告是對誰說的？

choices.why: 公告對象是 all employees，不是訪客。
警衛櫃檯只是領證地點。

q.t: What will happen next Monday?
q.zh: 下週一會發生什麼事？

choices.why: 大廳只是領取識別證的地點。
八點到五點是櫃檯服務時間。

choices.zh: 員工需要新的身分識別。
choices.why: 正解：new photo badge → new identification。

q.t: What are listeners asked to do?
q.zh: 聽眾被要求做什麼？

choices.zh: 打電話給 Lopez 女士
choices.why: 有問題才聯絡她，不是領證步驟。
只說要帶舊卡片去櫃檯。

choices.t: Pick up a badge in the lobby
choices.why: 正解：visit the security desk in the main lobby → pick up a badge in the lobby。

level.why: 電話留言含轉折與兩個方案，需同義換句與推論。

script.t: Hello, Ms. Chen. This is Paul calling from Harbor Grill about your reservation.
script.zh: 陳小姐您好，我是 Harbor Grill 的 Paul，來電是關於您的訂位。

script.t: I know you booked a table for twelve this Saturday at six p.m. for your company dinner.
script.zh: 我知道您訂了這週六下午六點十二人的位子，要辦公司聚餐。

script.t: Unfortunately, our private room will be closed that evening because of a plumbing problem.
script.zh: 很抱歉，由於水管問題，我們的包廂那晚會關閉。

script.t: However, we can seat your group on the terrace, which has a lovely view of the harbor.
script.zh: 不過，我們可以讓您的團體坐在露臺，那裡能看到美麗的港景。

script.t: The weather forecast says it might be cool, so we will provide heaters at no extra charge.
script.zh: 氣象預報說可能偏涼，所以我們會免費提供暖爐。

script.t: If you would prefer to keep the private room, we could move your dinner to Sunday at the same time.
script.zh: 如果您希望保留包廂，我們可以把聚餐改到週日同一時間。

script.t: Please call me back at 555-0148 before noon tomorrow so I can hold either option for you.
script.zh: 請在明天中午前回電 555-0148，我才能為您保留任一方案。

script.t: I will be in the restaurant until ten tonight, and after nine tomorrow morning.
script.zh: 我今晚會在餐廳到十點，明天早上九點之後也在。

script.t: Thank you, and we look forward to serving you.
script.zh: 謝謝您，期待為您服務。

q.t: Why is the speaker calling?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼來電？

choices.why: 水管問題只是包廂關閉的原因。

choices.t: To offer alternatives for a booking
choices.why: 正解：露臺或改到週日，是在處理訂位問題。

choices.t: To ask for a larger deposit

q.t: What can be inferred about the terrace?
q.zh: 關於露臺可以推論出什麼？

choices.why: 因水管問題關閉的是包廂。

choices.t: It may be chilly in the evening.
choices.why: 正解：might be cool → may be chilly；因此提供暖爐。

choices.t: It is smaller than the private room.
It is open only on Sundays.
choices.why: 週日是另一個聚餐日期選項。

q.t: What does the speaker ask Ms. Chen to do by noon tomorrow?
q.zh: 說話者請陳小姐在明天中午前做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：call me back → return his call。
他說自己會在餐廳，並非要她過去。

level.why: 廣告先講舊折扣再更正為新折扣，需對照圖表；含意圖題。

script.t: Looking for the perfect upgrade for your home office? Welcome to the Brightway Furniture Weekend Warehouse Sale.
script.zh: 想為居家辦公室找到最理想的升級嗎？歡迎來到 Brightway Furniture 的週末倉庫特賣。

script.t: This Saturday and Sunday only, every item in our office collection is marked down.
script.zh: 只限本週六、日，辦公家具系列的每件商品都降價。

script.t: Last week we advertised twenty percent off desks, but we have decided to do even better.
script.zh: 上週我們宣傳書桌打八折，但我們決定做得更好。

script.t: All desks are now thirty percent off, and chairs remain fifteen percent off.
script.zh: 現在所有書桌打七折，椅子仍是八五折。

script.t: Our bookshelves are twenty-five percent off, and filing cabinets are ten percent off.
script.zh: 書架打七五折，檔案櫃打九折。

script.t: Please note that lamps are not included in this promotion.
script.zh: 請注意燈具不在這次促銷範圍內。

script.t: If you spend more than five hundred dollars, we will deliver your purchase for free anywhere in the city.
script.zh: 如果消費超過五百美元，我們將免費配送到市內任何地點。

script.t: Otherwise, delivery costs forty dollars, and assembly is available for an additional fee.
script.zh: 否則運費為四十美元，組裝服務需另外收費。

script.t: Our warehouse is at 88 Dock Road, right behind the Greenfield train station.
script.zh: 倉庫位在 Dock Road 88 號，就在 Greenfield 火車站後面。

script.t: Free parking is available, but the lot fills up quickly on Saturday morning, so come early.
script.zh: 有免費停車位，但週六早上很快就滿，所以請早點來。

script.t: We open at nine and close at six both days. We hope to see you there!
script.zh: 兩天都是九點開門、六點打烊。希望在那裡見到您！

q.t: What is being advertised?
q.zh: 廣告的是什麼？

choices.why: 配送只是附帶的優惠條件。
正解：Weekend Warehouse Sale 是家具店的特賣活動。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which category received a larger discount than originally advertised?
q.zh: 請看圖表。哪個類別的折扣比原先宣傳的更大？

choices.why: 檔案櫃 10% 與圖表相同。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when he says, "the lot fills up quickly on Saturday morning"?
q.zh: 說話者說「週六早上停車場很快就滿」暗示什麼？

choices.why: 營業時間是九點到六點。
正解：停車位會很快滿，所以 come early。

level.why: 車站廣播含更正與推論，需同義換句。

script.t: Attention, passengers traveling to Riverside on the 4:15 express train.
script.zh: 前往 Riverside、搭乘 4:15 特快車的旅客請注意。

script.t: Due to a signal problem, this train will now depart from Platform 6 instead of Platform 3.
script.zh: 由於號誌問題，這班列車現在改從 6 號月台出發，而不是 3 號月台。

script.t: Passengers who are already waiting on Platform 3 should use the stairs near the ticket office.
script.zh: 已在 3 號月台等候的旅客，請利用售票處旁的樓梯。

script.t: The elevator is out of service, but station staff will assist anyone who needs help with luggage.
script.zh: 電梯停用，但站務人員會協助需要搬運行李的旅客。

script.t: The departure has been delayed by approximately twenty minutes, so the train will now leave at 4:35.
script.zh: 發車時間延誤約二十分鐘，所以列車現在將於 4:35 出發。

script.t: Tickets will remain valid, and no new reservation is required.
script.zh: 車票仍然有效，不需要重新劃位。

script.t: If you would like a refund, please visit the service counter near Gate B.
script.zh: 如果想退費，請到 B 閘門旁的服務櫃檯。

script.t: We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
script.zh: 對於造成的不便深表歉意，感謝您的耐心。

q.t: What is the announcement mainly about?
q.zh: 這則廣播主要是關於什麼？

choices.t: A change to a train schedule
choices.why: 正解：月台改變且延誤二十分鐘。

q.t: What can be inferred about the passengers on Platform 3?
q.zh: 關於 3 號月台的旅客可推論出什麼？

choices.why: 退費要自己到服務櫃檯。

choices.t: They need to move to another platform.
choices.zh: 他們需要換到另一個月台。
choices.why: 正解：列車改由 6 號月台出發，所以得移動。

q.t: What should passengers do if they want their money back?
q.zh: 旅客如果想退費該怎麼做？

choices.why: 正解：visit the service counter → go to a service counter。
售票處是旁邊樓梯的位置參照。

level.why: 簡短晨會提醒，答案幾乎照字面出現。

script.t: Good morning, team. Before we start loading trucks, I have a quick safety reminder.
script.zh: 各位早安。開始裝貨之前，我有一個簡短的安全提醒。

script.t: Yesterday, a forklift hit a stack of boxes in Aisle 5, and fortunately no one was hurt.
script.zh: 昨天有一台堆高機撞到第五走道的一堆箱子，幸好沒有人受傷。

script.t: From now on, all forklift drivers must slow down to five miles per hour in the aisles.
script.zh: 從現在起，所有堆高機駕駛在走道內必須減速到每小時五英里。

script.t: Everyone on the floor must also wear a yellow safety vest.
script.zh: 在作業區的每個人也都必須穿黃色安全背心。

script.t: You can pick up a vest from the cabinet next to my office.
script.zh: 你們可以到我辦公室旁的櫃子拿背心。

script.t: Next week, we will have a short training session on Wednesday afternoon.
script.zh: 下週三下午我們會有一場簡短的訓練課程。

script.t: That is all for now. Let us have a safe and productive day.
script.zh: 目前就這些。祝大家平安又有成效的一天。

q.t: What is the main topic of the talk?
q.zh: 這段談話的主題是什麼？

choices.why: 正解：減速與穿背心都是安全規定。
撞到的是箱子，但重點是新規定。

q.t: What are workers required to wear?
q.zh: 工作人員被要求穿戴什麼？

q.t: What will happen next Wednesday?
q.zh: 下週三會發生什麼事？

choices.why: 堆高機是昨天事故的主角。

choices.t: A training session will be held.
choices.why: 正解：we will have a training session → a training session will be held。

level.why: 電話留言先講舊方案再改新方案，需用樓層與容量對照圖表。

script.t: Hello, Mr. Okafor. This is Linda Park, the events coordinator at the Maple Grand Hotel.
script.zh: 歐卡佛先生您好，我是 Maple Grand 飯店的活動協調人 Linda Park。

script.t: I am calling about the sales conference you reserved for next Thursday.
script.zh: 我來電是關於您預訂下週四的業務會議。

script.t: When we spoke last month, I told you that the Crystal Ballroom would be available.
script.zh: 上個月我們談話時，我告訴過您水晶廳可以使用。

script.t: Unfortunately, that room has been double-booked, and I apologize for the error.
script.zh: 很遺憾，那個廳被重複預訂了，我為這個錯誤道歉。

script.t: I have looked at the other options, and I think the best choice is the room that seats a hundred and twenty on the second floor.
script.zh: 我查看過其他選項，我認為最好的選擇是二樓可容納一百二十人的廳。

script.t: I know you expect about a hundred guests, so that should be plenty of space.
script.zh: 我知道您預計大約一百位賓客，所以空間應該綽綽有餘。

script.t: It has the projector and microphones you requested.
script.zh: 它有您要求的投影機和麥克風。

script.t: The rate is the same as we quoted, so there will not be any extra cost to you.
script.zh: 費用和我們報價的一樣，所以您不需要額外付費。

script.t: Could you let me know by Monday whether this works for you?
script.zh: 您能在週一前告訴我這樣是否可行嗎？

script.t: If not, I can also offer you a smaller room with a free lunch for all attendees.
script.zh: 如果不行，我也可以提供較小的廳，並免費提供所有與會者午餐。

script.t: You can reach me at extension 310 or by email. Thank you for your understanding.
script.zh: 您可以撥分機 310 或用電子郵件聯絡我。感謝您的諒解。

q.t: Why is the speaker calling?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼來電？

choices.why: 免費午餐只是備案的附帶優惠。

choices.t: To inform a customer about a room change
choices.why: 正解：原訂水晶廳被重複預訂，改用其他廳。

choices.t: To ask for an extra payment

choices.why: 會議仍會舉行，只是換場地。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which room is the speaker offering?
q.zh: 請看圖表。說話者提供的是哪一間？

choices.why: 這是被重複預訂、無法使用的廳。
在二樓，但只容納 80 人。

q.t: What does the speaker ask Mr. Okafor to do?
q.zh: 說話者請歐卡佛先生做什麼？

choices.why: 正解：let me know whether this works → let her know his decision。

level.why: 導覽詞含規定與下雨備案，需推論。

script.t: Welcome to Willow Park Botanical Garden. My name is Grace, and I will be your guide this morning.
script.zh: 歡迎來到 Willow Park 植物園。我是 Grace，今天早上由我擔任您的導覽員。

script.t: Our tour will last about ninety minutes, and we will walk about two kilometers in total.
script.zh: 導覽約九十分鐘，我們總共會走約兩公里。

script.t: We will begin in the rose garden, which is at its best in early summer.
script.zh: 我們將從玫瑰園開始，初夏是它最美的時候。

script.t: After that, we will visit the greenhouse, where you can see plants from tropical regions.
script.zh: 之後我們會參觀溫室，在那裡可以看到熱帶地區的植物。

script.t: Please stay on the paths and do not touch the plants, since some of them are very delicate.
script.zh: 請留在步道上，也不要碰觸植物，因為有些非常脆弱。

script.t: Photography is welcome, but flash is not allowed inside the greenhouse.
script.zh: 歡迎拍照，但溫室內不可使用閃光燈。

script.t: At the end, we will stop at the gift shop, which offers a ten percent discount to tour participants.
script.zh: 最後我們會在紀念品店停留，參加導覽的人可享九折優惠。

script.t: If it starts to rain, we will continue the tour inside the greenhouse and skip the lake.
script.zh: 如果開始下雨，我們會在溫室內繼續導覽，並略過湖區。

script.t: Now, if everyone is ready, please follow me.
script.zh: 現在，如果大家都準備好了，請跟我來。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?
q.zh: 說話者最可能是誰？

choices.why: 紀念品店只是行程最後一站。
正解：I will be your guide → 園區的導覽人員。

q.t: What is not allowed inside the greenhouse?
q.zh: 溫室內不允許什麼？

choices.why: 正解：flash is not allowed → using a camera flash。

q.t: What will happen if it rains?
q.zh: 如果下雨會怎樣？

choices.why: 折扣是導覽的固定優惠。

choices.t: Part of the tour will be skipped.
choices.why: 正解：skip the lake → part of the tour will be skipped。
